_what: Mirage IIIE: hand-built filler pieces between the canopy frame and the airframe's skin. Every vertex is written out by hand in vehicle-local blocks (x left, y up, z forward); the build step (canopy_mirage_3e.py, hand_fill_bars) only reads this file and emits each face as written, in the frame's own colour, with its normal away from the piece's middle. A piece is a closed solid: its buried part sits inside the airframe, its exposed top follows the skin 2.5 mm proud (never coplanar). Read off cross-sections and first-hit maps at the spots (cockpit_audit/fixes_mirage/xsec.py, topmap.py, the audit --images).

pieces.name: bar_pocket_right
pieces.why: windscreen base bar, right: the deck plate's edge (x 0.175) drops 3 cm to the nose skin beside the bar's ear (z 5.062). This ramp carries the plate's top (y 1.9525 at x 0.170) down to the skin (y 1.9135 at x 0.200), z 4.990 .. 5.062, and sits 2.8 cm into the airframe underneath.

pieces.name: bar_pocket_left
pieces.why: windscreen base bar, left: the same ramp, mirrored.
